{{Top|leg}}
'''Light-amplification visors''' were optical devices that enhanced a wearer's vision in darkness. However, they were susceptible to being overwhelmed by sudden bright flashes, making [[Flash grenade/Legends|flash grenades]] an effective countermeasure against them.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the [[Galactic Alliance Army]] troopers attacked the [[Unsafe house|safe house]] of [[Wraith Squadron]], a recently reformed [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, while wearing light-amplification visors.<ref name="MK" />
